title: Show running audit progress
summary: Keep the Reports Audit start surface visibly running after the backend accepts an audit start, including an elapsed timer, disabled Start Audit button, scheduled refreshes, fallback indeterminate progress, and a non-evidence Audit Progress panel.
reason: Large audits can keep running after /api/audit/start returns. The Reports UI previously returned the Start Audit button to an apparently idle/clickable state, leaving no immediate in-page progress/status signal that the audit was still active.
behavior_before: After a successful Reports audit start POST, the UI showed Started only briefly and re-enabled Start Audit as soon as the POST completed. If the refreshed snapshot had not yet loaded audit_progress.json, the page had no timer, bar, or running indicator.
behavior_after: After backend acceptance, Reports records the accepted audit start locally, disables Start Audit as Audit Running, shows Running mm:ss plus PID/library/ETA-unavailable detail, renders an indeterminate audit progress row, and schedules follow-up refreshes. Fresh backend audit progress replaces the local fallback and terminal backend progress clears it. The live Audit Progress panel is classified as status, not evidence, so it remains visible without the evidence chip/styling.
tests_added: Updated tests/python/desktop/test_reports_view_static.py to guard Reports audit running-state helpers, copy, and non-evidence Audit Progress panel classification.
Updated tests/webview/test_webview_browser_maintenance_reports_smoke.py to verify Start Audit remains disabled with visible running/progress detail after backend acceptance.
